title: Sign in to Terma
description: Enter the Web access password. If only an access token is configured, enter that token instead.
setup_hint: First use: set a Web password in Terma on the device running the service. After signing in, you can change it in Settings > Security.
fnos_setup_hint: Use the Web password chosen during installation. To set or reset it, open fnOS App Center > Terma > Application Settings. This is Terma's own password; no username is required.
protocol_mismatch: The browser and backend use different HTTPS/HTTP protocols. Your password has not been checked. For HTTPS forwarding to HTTP, open Terma at a working address, then turn off “Check HTTPS/HTTP origin protocol” in Settings > Security. On fnOS, you can also use App Center > Terma > Application Settings.
origin_forbidden: Request origin checking failed before your password was checked. Open Terma at a working address and check Allowed Hosts, ports and HTTPS/HTTP origin protocol in Settings > Security. NAS packages may also offer application settings.
not_configured: No Web password or access token has been configured
invalid: The password or token is incorrect
temporarily_locked: The password or token is incorrect. Sign-in is locked for {{seconds}} seconds
too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds
host_not_allowed: Access host {{host}} is not allowed. Your password has not been checked. Open a working address and add {{host}} to Allowed Hosts in Terma Settings > Security, or fnOS Application Settings. Enter only a domain or IP, optionally with a port; omit the scheme and path.
origin_host_mismatch: The app or relay sent origin {{source_origin}}, but the service received host {{request_host}}. Your password has not been checked. Preserve the original host at the relay. On fnOS, use a working address to add the trusted relay domain or IP in Settings > Security or Terma runtime settings in App Center. Omit the scheme and port; changing HTTPS ports are supported. Only authorize an entry you trust.
origin_port_mismatch: Origin {{source_origin}} and received host {{request_host}} use different ports. Your password has not been checked. Check whether the relay preserves the public port. You can open the same link in an external browser for now.
origin_invalid: The app or browser did not send a valid HTTP/HTTPS origin. Your password has not been checked. Open the same link in an external browser, or check the embedded page’s origin restrictions.
